name: card
changelog: The card gains layouts without changing the common case: `media` puts an image before the content (`FlCardMedia`, `radiusXxl` corners, or `bleed` to the edges), above or at the start when `axis` is horizontal; `background` fills the whole card under the content; `trailing` pins a button in the top end corner, `space.md` from the edges, and the first child moves away from it; `spacing` sets the gap between children. `FlCardHeader` and `FlCardBody` take a `spacing`, `FlCardFooter` an `alignment` (`WrapAlignment.start` keeps its children together). The default rendering does not change.
title: Card
description: Groups a header, a title, a description and actions on a shadowed surface: a product, an offer, an account summary.
